_comment: One schema drives both provisioning routes: the agent's dev-tenant tool (python -m devtenant sp-provision) and the ContosoHelpDeskProvisionList flow that example/build.py generates for a manual import. Internal names never contain spaces; display names may (Power Fx then uses the display name in single quotes, e.g. 'Requester Email'). The built-in Title column is renamed 'Subject' for display but Power Fx still calls it Title.
